Narrow personal-privacy utility for auditing and bulk-deleting your own Reddit comment history via the Reddit API; it is not a general dataset-curation tool for identifying or removing problematic data from training corpora.

It statistically estimates differential-privacy epsilon from the confusion matrix of a membership-inference attack; this is privacy-budget accounting/auditing, not identification/removal of problematic data, license handling, or eval-time contamination detection, so it does not fit any of RQ1-6.

MemAlign is a judge-alignment optimizer bundled inside MLflow, a very large general-purpose MLOps/AI-engineering platform, so it is not an independently distributable standalone tool, and the available README is for the whole platform and provides no evidence about MemAlign itself.

The Model Compression Toolkit performs quantization (PTQ/GPTQ/QAT) to shrink models for edge hardware; it reduces compute but provides no facility for measuring or reporting energy use, emissions or any other environmental impact, so RQ98 does not fit.

Intel Neural Compressor is a quantization and model-compression library (static/dynamic/weight-only quantization, QAT, mixed precision); it optimises inference efficiency but offers no measurement or accounting of energy consumption or environmental impact, so RQ98 does not fit.
